title: Blank screen in the Android release build only, no crash, nothing reported
notes: The bisect is already almost done and the agent should notice: it works in debug on Android and in release on iOS, so the variable is Android + release specifically, which points at R8/ProGuard or a __DEV__ branch rather than at anything in the React tree. 'Nothing in Crashlytics' should be read as unreliable evidence rather than as proof of no error — an unverified crash reporter is the classic case of an empty dashboard meaning broken telemetry. Correct next steps are adb logcat against the release build and a temporary R8-off build to isolate. The failure mode being tested is proposing a list of generic React fixes without using the platform/build-type evidence already given.

expect.name: uses the platform-and-build-type intersection to narrow the cause
names R8 or ProGuard as a leading suspect
proposes logcat against the release build to get real evidence
proposes disabling R8 temporarily as an isolation test rather than a fix
treats the empty crash dashboard as unverified rather than as evidence of no error

proposes generic React render fixes despite the platform evidence
